newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Fahd hopes for peace, stability in Moslem new year.
- Saudi interior minister says probe finds Mena fire was accidental.
- Saudis to develop Tunisian-Libyan offshore oil field.
- Saudi Arabia is free from organised crime.
- Saudi Arabia executes Indian man for smuggling heroin.
- Tabuk Agricultural Development Company shareholders to get five percent cash dividend.
